metadata.case_name: MAHMOOD, NAZIR v. CHIN WAI ON AND PUN WAI MING T/A KENZ ENGINEERING CO AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: Casual construction site worker; casual labourer employed by Kenz Engineering Company
plaintiff.education_level: Educated in Pakistan; left school at age 18

injuries.description: Soft tissue sprain of the lower back (lumbar sprain)
source: I accept Dr Wongs conclusions that Mr Mahmood suffered a soft tissue sprain as a result of the sudden and unexpected burden of extra weight put upon his back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: Slight left posterior protrusion at the L5/S1 disc (disc protrusion / degenerative disc change)
source: a slight left posterior protrusion at the L5/S1 disc and a mild difference in signal intensity compared with the remaining lumbar discs.
The protrusion is the result of disc degeneration, exacerbated by the heavy duty work of manual labouring.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: Severe lower back pain; constant mild pain with bouts of very bad pain on occasion
Heard a cracking sound as if something had broken at his back at time of injury
Unable to walk without the use of a walking frame initially
Needed a walking stick for about a month
Limitation in trunk flexion and extension about 1/3 of full range of motion
Muscles on either side of the spine were tense
No neurological sign / no neurovascular deficit
Cannot carry anything weighing more than 15 kgs without feeling pain
Residual back pain that might re-occur after heavy or prolonged lifting or carrying

treatments_future: avoid heavy manual work / avoid lifting and carrying heavy loads

losses.description: Construction site work and heavy manual labour is beyond him because of inability to handle weights; must avoid lifting and carrying heavy materials

comparable_cases.case_name: Lai Kam Wah v Wing & Kwong Co. Ltd
Mahmood Tariq v Kinway Engineering Ltd
